name: geeks-learning-platform
description: Academic full-stack reproduction of a GeeksforGeeks-style learning platform (Nuxt 4 + Express + Prisma + PostgreSQL)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,executor,frontend -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w executor" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n db,backend,executor,frontend -c yellow,blue,magenta,green "npm run db:start" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w executor" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w executor && npm run build -w frontend
